title: Exercise 1: Future Tenses Contrast
theory:
Future Tenses (Will, Going to, Present Continuous)

Elige la forma de futuro correcta. Presta atención al contexto (decisiones espontáneas, intenciones, predicciones o planes confirmados).

items.q: 1. I've bought the tickets! We ___ to Tokyo next month to see the new smart city.
items.why: Planes confirmados (Present Continuous).

items.q: 2. Look at those dark clouds! It ___ heavily.
items.why: Predicción con evidencia visual (Going to).

items.q: 3. A: 'I don't know how to use this new app.' B: 'Don't worry, I ___ you.'
items.why: Decisión espontánea en el momento (Will).

items.q: 4. Next year, the government ___ a new renewable energy plant. The plans are already approved.
items.why: Intención o plan con evidencia/aprobación (Going to).

items.q: 5. I think people ___ flying cars in 2050, but I'm not sure.
items.why: Predicción general u opinión (Will).

items.q: 6. We ___ the environmental committee at 10 AM tomorrow. It's in my calendar.
items.why: Acuerdo fijo en calendario (Present Continuous).

items.q: 7. A: 'We have no milk.' B: 'Really? I ___ to the supermarket now to buy some.'
items.why: Decisión espontánea al enterarse (Will).

items.q: 8. A: 'Why are you taking your laptop?' B: 'Because I ___ on the train.'
items.why: Intención ya pensada de antemano (Going to).

items.q: 9. The new smartphones ___ a lot of money next year.
items.why: Predicción con 'probably' (Will).

items.q: 10. I ___ lunch with my boss on Friday to discuss the new project.
items.why: Acuerdo fijo o cita (Present Continuous).

title: Exercise 2: Conditionals
theory:
Conditionals: Real or Hypothetical?

Completa las oraciones con la forma correcta de los verbos entre paréntesis para formar First o Second Conditionals.

items.q: 1. If we ___ (use) more renewable energy, climate change ___ (slow) down. (First Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura del First Conditional.

items.q: 2. If I ___ (be) the president, I ___ (ban) all plastic bags. (Second Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura del Second Conditional.

items.q: 3. What ___ you ___ (do) if you ___ (lose) your smartphone? (Second Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura de pregunta del Second Conditional.

items.q: 4. If she ___ (not/study) hard, she ___ (not/pass) the university exam tomorrow. (First Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura negativa del First Conditional.

items.q: 5. We ___ (save) a lot of water if everyone ___ (take) shorter showers. (Second Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura del Second Conditional.

items.q: 6. If the new app ___ (be) successful, the company ___ (make) millions. (First Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura del First Conditional.

items.q: 7. I ___ (buy) an electric car if I ___ (have) enough money, but they are too expensive. (Second Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura del Second Conditional.

items.q: 8. If we ___ (not/recycle) our garbage, the pollution ___ (get) worse. (First Conditional)
items.why: Revisa la estructura negativa del First Conditional.

title: Exercise 3: Spot the B1 Mistakes
theory:
Spot the B1 Mistakes

Encuentra el error gramatical en cada oración y escribe la versión correcta. ¡Busca errores clásicos de condicionales y futuros!

items.q: 1. If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.why: Recuerda las reglas de los condicionales.

items.q: 2. I promise I am going to help you with your homework tonight.
items.why: Revisa los tiempos futuros para promesas.

items.q: 3. If I have a million dollars, I would travel around the world.
items.why: Revisa la mezcla incorrecta de condicionales.

items.q: 4. What would you do if you win the lottery?
items.why: Revisa el Second Conditional.

items.q: 5. We are going to a meeting at 3 PM tomorrow, it's on our schedule.
items.why: Revisa el uso de present continuous para planes fijos.

title: Exercise 4: Key Word Transformations
theory:
Key Word Transformations (Integrated Review)

Reescribe las oraciones manteniendo el significado exacto, usando la palabra entre paréntesis.

items.q: 1. It is a good idea to install this new security app. (SHOULD) -> You ____________________ this new security app.
items.why: Usa should para dar consejos.

items.q: 2. It is not necessary for us to print these documents. (HAVE) -> We ____________________ print these documents.
items.why: Usa don't have to para falta de obligación.

items.q: 3. I am planning to buy a new smart TV next week. (GOING) -> I ____________________ a new smart TV next week.
items.why: Usa going to para planes.

items.q: 4. I advise you to recycle plastic. (OUGHT) -> You ____________________ plastic.
items.why: Usa ought to para consejos.

items.q: 5. The man is a scientist. He invented the new battery. (WHO) -> The man ____________________ is a scientist.
items.why: Usa una relative clause.

items.q: 6. It is strictly prohibited to throw batteries in the normal bin. (MUSTN'T) -> You ____________________ batteries in the normal bin.
items.why: Usa mustn't para prohibiciones.
